origin.description: Generic for coercing to Formula; the default method coerces to formula then calls Formula, and the formula method can merge several formulas on the lhs and rhs.
origin.example: as.Formula on a regressor formula and a one-sided formula, then class, length, deparse, and lhs/rhs attributes
